"July 14th," said Chen, not taking her eyes off the Earth below.
"Me too," Yamamoto replied, and for the first time in three months, they both looked at each other.
"That's —"
"Two in one crew. Statistically impossible."
"Statistically improbable," Chen corrected. "We're already doing the impossible."
They sat in silence for a moment, tethered to the station but, in that instant, tethered to each other by something stranger than gravity. On the same day, twelve years apart, in a city neither had named, they had drawn their first breaths. And now they were breathing the same recycled air, orbiting the same blue marble, sharing the same improbable sky.
